hooks.name: module-docs-sync
hooks.description: Update documentation and create test skeleton when new engine modules are added

action.prompt: A new engine module file was created. Your task: (1) Add or update its entry in docs/module-reference.md with the module's type, category, input/output ports, config fields extracted from its Zod schema, and a brief example snippet. (2) If this is a new module with a themed name, update the themed-label table in .kiro/steering/product.md with the mapping of themed label to plain name. (3) Ensure a colocated test file <name>.test.ts exists with fast-check property tests; if missing, create a skeleton test file. Do not modify any other files.
